text: In Genesis 22 the three days of travel are like a suspended sentence; to outward appearance nothing happens, while in significance everything happens. Faith here has the form of a structured relation or arrangement; it is not primarily a matter of feeling. Obedience remains with horror, and neither is suffered to prevail. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with care, and the instruments of the act are present before the act itself occurs.
